narrative:
@Saoirse: I told you once I used to guard a Royal Heir. What I didn't say is why I stopped. I was on duty the night a woman came to see my charge privately - Lady Ysolde Marrow, though I didn't know her name yet. I wasn't supposed to let her in without clearance. I did anyway, because she was, and is, very good at being let in. Whatever was said in that room, my charge was different afterward. Colder. More careful about who they trusted. I started asking questions I wasn't supposed to ask. I left before anyone had to decide what to do about that.

She says it flat, the way she says everything hard. @Saoirse: Ysolde Marrow does not forget people who ask the wrong questions. Apparently three years is not long enough for her to stop caring about it.
